{{Quote|You look very well, my daughter. But always remember&mdash;hide who you are from the sisterhood or your mother will destroy you.|The ghost of Ros Lai's father|<ref name="SWIE2" />}}
'''Ros Lai's father''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When he was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] on a mission, this [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and taken as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] by the witch [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]]. As it was customary in the Dathomiri witches' culture, Zalem [[Death/Legends|killed]] her husband after mating. Their daughter, [[Ros Lai]], grew in the hate of her mother, and swore she would avenge the murder of a father she never knew.<ref name="SWIE2" />
